jj.badge.conflict.description: A badge on a jj commit storing unresolved conflicts (HI-2799). Lower case.

jj.badge.divergent.description: A badge on a jj commit whose change id names several commits (HI-2799). Lower case.

jj.badge.divergentTip.defaultMessage: This change id names more than one commit: refer to this one by its commit id. Combwork never picks one.
jj.badge.divergentTip.description: Tooltip of the divergent badge in jj’s History (HI-2799).

jj.badge.empty.description: A badge on a jj commit with no changes (HI-2799). Lower case.

jj.badge.workingCopy.description: A badge on the jj working-copy commit (@) of the project folder (HI-2799). Lower case.

jj.bookmarks.conflict.description: A conflicted jj bookmark (HI-2799): it names several commits ({sides}, short ids).

jj.bookmarks.name.description: A column of jj’s Bookmarks (HI-2799): the name (and remote).

jj.bookmarks.none.description: jj’s Bookmarks section (HI-2799) when there are none.

jj.bookmarks.notInGit.description: A badge on a jj bookmark whose Git branch differs (HI-2799): not exported yet, or Git moved it. Lower case. Keep Git.

jj.bookmarks.note.defaultMessage: Bookmarks are created, moved and pushed with jj itself: Combwork only shows them.
jj.bookmarks.note.description: A note in jj’s Bookmarks section (HI-2799). Keep jj.

jj.bookmarks.target.description: A column of jj’s Bookmarks (HI-2799): the change and commit it names.

jj.compare.ambiguous.defaultMessage: {rev} names {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}}: pick one by its commit id.
jj.compare.ambiguous.description: jj’s Compare (HI-2799): the id is ambiguous (a divergent change id, or a prefix of several): Combwork never picks one.

jj.compare.bad.defaultMessage: Type a bookmark, a change id or a commit id.
jj.compare.bad.description: jj’s Compare (HI-2799): a field holds something else (spaces, symbols).

jj.compare.capped.defaultMessage: The diff is long: only its start is shown.
jj.compare.capped.description: Under a jj diff in Compare (HI-2799) cut at its limit.

jj.compare.files.defaultMessage: {n, plural, =0 {No files changed} one {# file changed} other {# files changed}}
jj.compare.files.description: jj’s Compare (HI-2799): how many files differ.

jj.compare.from.description: A field of jj’s Compare (HI-2799): the older revision (a bookmark, change id or commit id).

jj.compare.none.description: jj’s Compare (HI-2799): no revision has that name or id.

jj.compare.pick.description: A button beside one of the commits an ambiguous id names in jj’s Compare (HI-2799): puts its commit id in the field.

jj.compare.to.description: A field of jj’s Compare (HI-2799): the newer revision.

jj.conflicts.files.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# conflicted file} other {# conflicted files}}

jj.conflicts.intro.defaultMessage: jj can keep a conflict in a commit and carry on. These commits store conflicts; resolve them with jj in a terminal (jj resolve).
jj.conflicts.intro.description: The top of jj’s Conflicts section (HI-2799). Keep jj and jj resolve (a command).

jj.conflicts.none.description: jj’s Conflicts section (HI-2799) when there are none.

jj.history.capped.defaultMessage: Only the latest {n, number} are shown.
jj.history.capped.description: Under jj’s History (HI-2799) when there are more commits than shown.

jj.ids.tip.description: Tooltip of a jj commit’s ids (HI-2799): both in full.

jj.integrate.card.description: A passed card in jj’s “Waiting for you to integrate” (HI-2799). {commit} is its reviewed commit (short), {target} the bookmark it goes into.

jj.integrate.contained.description: Under a passed jj card (HI-2799): whether its reviewed work is in its target. Combwork can’t check it yet (a later version records it); never read as not integrated.

jj.integrate.head.description: A heading of the jj Repository section (HI-2799, option A): cards that passed review, which the user brings into their target themselves.

jj.integrate.how.defaultMessage: For example, then move {target} to the rebased commit with jj bookmark set:
jj.integrate.how.description: Above a jj command suggested to integrate a passed card (HI-2799): rebase it onto its target, then move the target bookmark. Keep jj bookmark set (a command).

jj.integrate.noMerge.defaultMessage: Combwork doesn’t merge under jj: integrate the reviewed work with jj yourself.
jj.integrate.noMerge.description: A note under jj’s “Waiting for you to integrate” (HI-2799, Darren’s decision A). Keep jj.

jj.integrate.none.description: Under “Waiting for you to integrate” (HI-2799) when no card has passed.

jj.readFailed.description: A jj section couldn’t be read (HI-2799). {error} says why.

jj.reading.description: While a jj section of the Version Control tab is read (HI-2799).

jj.refresh.description: A button in a jj section of the Version Control tab (HI-2799): reads it again.

jj.repo.colocated.defaultMessage: {colocated, select, yes {Colocated with Git: Git sees the same history.} other {Not colocated with Git.}}
jj.repo.colocated.description: The jj Repository section (HI-2799): whether a .git is beside .jj. Keep Git.

jj.repo.edits.defaultMessage: jj has no uncommitted changes: edits are recorded in the working-copy commit when jj snapshots them.
jj.repo.edits.description: A note in the jj Repository section (HI-2799), in place of Git’s Changes. Keep jj.

jj.repo.op.description: The jj Repository section (HI-2799): jj’s current operation (its id, short), which every view is read at.

jj.repo.root.description: The jj Repository section (HI-2799): the repository’s folder.

jj.repo.unsupported.defaultMessage: Not supported with jj in Combwork
jj.repo.unsupported.description: A heading of the jj Repository section (HI-2799): what Combwork doesn’t do or support with jj. Keep jj.

jj.repo.version.description: The jj Repository section (HI-2799): the jj version Combwork uses. Keep jj.

jj.repo.workspace.description: A jj workspace in the Repository section (HI-2799): its name and its working copy’s change id and commit id (short).

jj.repo.workspaces.description: A heading of the jj Repository section (HI-2799): jj’s workspaces (working folders) of this repository, Combwork’s slots among them.

jj.row.change.description: A column of jj’s History (HI-2799): the change id (stable across rewrites).

jj.row.commit.description: A column of jj’s History (HI-2799): the commit id (this exact version).

jj.row.noDescription.description: A jj commit with an empty description (HI-2799).

jj.unknown.heads.defaultMessage: jj’s operation log has {detail} heads: Combwork reads nothing until jj reconciles them (any jj command in a terminal does).
jj.unknown.heads.description: A jj section can’t be read (HI-2799): jj’s operation log diverged (or can’t be read). {detail} is how many heads, or “unreadable”. Keep jj.

jj.unknown.moved.defaultMessage: The repository changed while it was read: refresh to read it again.
jj.unknown.moved.description: A jj section can’t be read (HI-2799): jj recorded an operation while Combwork read.

jj.unknown.noRepo.defaultMessage: No jj repository was found here.
jj.unknown.noRepo.description: A jj section can’t be read (HI-2799): the project folder has no jj repository (any more). Keep jj.

jj.unknown.other.description: A jj section can’t be read (HI-2799). {code} is a short code for why, kept in English, with jj’s own words after it. Keep jj.

jj.unknown.tool.defaultMessage: jj isn’t installed, or isn’t the version Combwork is tested with, so nothing is read through it.
jj.unknown.tool.description: A jj section can’t be read (HI-2799): the jj tool. Keep jj.
